mistake_reason: At step 18, the Assistant performed a flawed verification that only checked trivial properties (positivity, broad range bounds, and rerunning the same pipeline on the same data) and interpreted this as validating correctness of the extracted datasets against the image. This verification test inherently passes regardless of data quality or misclassification and does not cross-check the numbers against the source. As a result, an incorrect dataset and computed average (10.858) were falsely approved, exemplifying FM-3.3 Incorrect Verification.
